title: Mixing: Oriental Nightfish by Linda McCartney | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney

Wings attended a mixing session for Linda McCartney’s song ‘Oriental Nightfish’ on 24 February 1978.

The song had been recorded on 4 October 1973, and was revived on 6 December 1977 for possible inclusion in the soundtrack of an animated film directed by Ian Emes.

Work on the animation was progressing, and it was due to premiere at the Cannes Film Festival in May 1978. For that reason it was mixed in stereo on this day.

At AIR Studios, Denny Laine met guitarist Laurence Juber, whom he had met during an appearance on the BBC TV show David Essex on 27 September. Juber was part of the house band that backed Laine for a performance of ‘Go Now’.

Juber was invited into the control room during this session, and was introduced to the rest of Wings. He was invited to audition with the band on 28 April 1978.
